diagnosis.hypothesis: Observed only guest1<->web1 connectivity failing initially: guest1 to web1 had 100% loss and web1 to guest1 returned 'Destination Net Unreachable' from 10.10.40.1. Confirmed leaf1 had guest subnet 10.10.20.1/24 locally, while leaf2 lacked route 10.10.20.0/24. Added static route 10.10.20.0/24 on leaf2 via 10.255.0.4 toward leaf1. Re-validation passed public success criteria with all tested IPv4 paths succeeding.
diagnosis.reference: On leaf2, the static route to 10.10.20.0/24 (toward guest1 in guest_vlan) points to next hop 192.0.2.1, which cannot be resolved (no such neighbour), so the route is unusable.

arguments.reason: Validation shows only guest1<->web1 fails with web1 receiving destination net unreachable from 10.10.40.1. leaf1 has 10.10.20.1/24 locally, but leaf2 lacks an active route to 10.10.20.0/24 while it has static routes for other remote VLANs. Point the missing guest subnet route from leaf2 toward leaf1 over the direct fabric link 10.255.0.4/31 peer.
